Devkitty 1.0.0 (build 304)

Changes since build 300.

Build 304: Terminal search, standard shortcuts, quieter reconnects

  • Cmd+F opens a search bar in the focused terminal, with a match count and next/previous buttons (Return, Shift+Return, Cmd+G, Shift+Cmd+G). Esc closes it. The bar follows Sunset and sits above widgets.
  • Ctrl+Tab and Ctrl+Shift+Tab switch workspaces. New standard shortcuts: Cmd+Opt+Up/Down move pane focus, Ctrl+Cmd+= equalizes panes, Ctrl+Cmd+arrows resize panes, Ctrl+Cmd+F and Cmd+Return go full screen, Cmd+9 jumps to the last workspace.
  • When a terminal's connection ends, the tab closes if its shell ended, and a live session reconnects quietly. The old "connection ended" message is gone.
  • Sidebar sections and separators are removed. Existing separators are removed on update, and tab order is kept.
  • Double-click the empty part of the expanded sidebar to open a new terminal. Before, this worked only in the icon-only sidebar.
  • The sidebar selection highlight stays on its row after moves and reorders.
  • The tab strip no longer moves up when many tabs overflow and the Mac shows classic scroll bars.
  • The collapsed right sidebar now defaults to Hidden.
  • Browser tabs no longer flash white on launch in dark mode or Sunset.
